health_rank_orientation.HIGHER_HEALTHIER: ascending value order; smallest value receives the lowest health rank
health_rank_orientation.LOWER_HEALTHIER: descending value order; largest value receives the lowest health rank

quarter_continuity: adjacent reported quarter-end observations for that institution
bank_quarter_warning_evaluable: at least two factor ranks are evaluable at the quarter
bank_failure_evaluable: at least one pre-failure quarter is warning-evaluable after rolling histories mature
missing_factor_rule: missing/unevaluable factor receives no impaired or healthy credit and is excluded from additive mean
persistent_warning_break_rule: any adjacent reported quarter that does not satisfy the >=2 impaired-factor condition breaks persistence
acute_warning_rule: unchanged from CP1: >=3 impaired factors in one quarter
first_warning_rule: earliest qualifying persistent or acute pre-failure quarter-end
